slots.text: Earn $20,000, own 5 machines and reach reputation 4
Earn $60,000, own 7 machines and reach reputation 7

dig.name: Digger operator
dig.text: Digs out your field with a digger and heaps it beside, sorted by material if they're good at it.

haul.name: Haulage driver
haul.text: Loads material from your heaps, drives it to the depot and sells it in the best bay.

sales.name: Sales and office
sales.text: Gets a better price for every load sold, and takes on work from the jobs board.

mechanic.name: Fitter
mechanic.text: Services and repairs your machines without being asked, and cuts the cost of the work.
